title: "日報"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{python}
import os
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime

# 獲取報告目錄
reports_dir = Path("assets/reports")

# 獲取所有日期文件夾 (格式: YYYY-MM-DD)
date_dirs = sorted([d for d in reports_dir.iterdir() 
                   if d.is_dir() and len(d.name) == 10 and d.name[4] == '-' and d.name[7] == '-'],
                  reverse=True)

# 查找最新的報告
latest_date = None
if date_dirs:
    latest_dir = date_dirs[0]
    latest_date = latest_dir.name
    zh_pdf = latest_dir / "financial_report_zh.pdf"
    en_pdf = latest_dir / "financial_report_en.pdf"
```

## 最新報告

```{python}
if latest_date and (latest_dir / "financial_report_zh.pdf").exists():
    print(f"**報告日期：{latest_date}**")
else:
    print("暫無最新報告")
```

::: {.pdf-frame}
```{python}
if latest_date and (latest_dir / "financial_report_zh.pdf").exists():
    print(f'<iframe src="assets/reports/{latest_date}/financial_report_zh.pdf" width="100%" height="900" style="border: none;" title="最新財務日報 PDF"></iframe>')
else:
    print('<p style="color: #666;">報告未就緒，請稍候...</p>')
```
:::

```{python}
if latest_date and (latest_dir / "financial_report_zh.pdf").exists():
    print(f'- [開啟最新報告](assets/reports/{latest_date}/financial_report_zh.pdf)')
```

## 過往報告

所有可用的報告可在下方下載：

```{python}
if date_dirs:
    print("| 日期 | 中文版 | 英文版 |")
    print("|------|--------|--------|")
    for date_dir in date_dirs[:30]:  # 顯示最新 30 個報告
        date = date_dir.name
        zh_exists = (date_dir / "financial_report_zh.pdf").exists()
        en_exists = (date_dir / "financial_report_en.pdf").exists()
        
        zh_link = f"[下載](assets/reports/{date}/financial_report_zh.pdf)" if zh_exists else "—"
        en_link = f"[下載](assets/reports/{date}/financial_report_en.pdf)" if en_exists else "—"
        
        print(f"| {date} | {zh_link} | {en_link} |")
else:
    print("暫無報告記錄")
```
